verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents the Pipelines and Track APIs for sending customer data and identifying people, publishes an OpenAPI spec, and explicitly supports suppressing (and deleting) profiles via API through a 'Suppress Person' event. That covers the create/update/suppress core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of setting custom attributes on identify calls (only implied via attribute-based segments), evidence of production-scale throughput such as batch endpoints or rate limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
